findings.message: No check resolves the two new subpath exports. No test imports `@pirate-sea-race/simulation/fruits` (the tests use ./index.js). The build smoke (scripts/smoke-build.ts WORKSPACE_EXPORTS, lines 32-54, run by `npm run build`) loads every other subpath from dist/, but not `@pirate-sea-race/simulation/fruits` or `@pirate-sea-race/content/fruits`. So nothing proves that the `default` -> ./dist/fruits/index.js entries resolve and load, including the runtime import of `@pirate-sea-race/content/fruits` in the built simulation. scripts/ belongs to rubbings-theft-fixes, so the two specifiers should be added to WORKSPACE_EXPORTS when the operator resolves the merge. Every other acceptance item (dealing, eating, contests over permutations, commitment, properties with EXERCISED, the content validator refusing eatTicks 0, purity over the new src directories) has real asserting tests, and the candidate unit log shows they ran (fruits.test.ts 20, property.test.ts 121, content fruits.test.ts 5, purity 10).
findings.requirement: (`@pirate-sea-race/simulation/fruits`, `@pirate-sea-race/content/fruits`, following the existing pattern with the `@pirate-sea-race/source` condition first)
